entry.title: Restaurant Radar: CA Liquor License Applications · Westworks
entry.summary: Weekly pending on-premise liquor-license applications in your California counties, from California ABC records. $29 for 30 days or $69 for 90 days, no renewal.

entry.title: Snow Ledger: Snow & Ice Records for Your Lot · Westworks
entry.summary: Every snow and ice event near your lot this season, set up before the first billable storm: times, inches, ice, NOAA sources. $79 per ZIP. Uncertified.

entry.summary: Free E-Rate invoice deadline lookup: funded FRNs with no BEAR or SPI invoice received yet, the last date to invoice and extension status, by school, library or BEN.
